ko.title: 1,904달러의 프리미엄: 2,200만 미국人が 이미 ACA 보조금 종료를 느끼고 있는 방법

segments.src: ## A Quiet Deadline With a Loud Impact
segments.tr: ## 조용한 마감일과 큰 영향

segments.src: At the stroke of midnight on December 31, 2025, a temporary but consequential piece of pandemic-era policy quietly expired.
segments.tr: 2025년 12월 31일 자정에, 일시적이지만 의미 있는 전염병 시대 정책이 조용히 만료되었습니다.

segments.src: The enhanced premium tax credits for Affordable Care Act (ACA) marketplace plans — first introduced in 2021 and extended through 2025 — were allowed to lapse.
segments.tr: ACA 시장 계획을 위한 강화된 프리미엄 세금 공제 — 2021년에 처음 도입되어 2025년까지 연장됨 — 만료되었습니다.

segments.src: For millions of households who buy their own health insurance through HealthCare.gov or a state exchange, the change did not arrive with fanfare.
segments.tr: HealthCare.gov 또는 주 교환을 통해 자신의 건강 보험을 구매하는 수백만 가구에게는 변경이 화려한 환영과 함께 도착하지 않았습니다.

segments.src: It arrived with a bill.
segments.tr: それは請求書と一緒にやってきました.

segments.src: According to marketplace enrollment data, the average annual amount enrollees paid out of pocket for coverage had been about $888 while the enhanced credits were in effect.
segments.tr: 시장 등록 데이터에 따르면, 강화된 공제가 적용되는 동안 등록자의 보험료를 위해 지불한 평균 연간 금액은 약 888달러였습니다.

segments.src: Now, with those credits gone, many shoppers are seeing that number climb toward an average of roughly $1,904 a year — more than double what they budgeted for just months earlier.
segments.tr: 이제 공제가 사라지면서 많은 쇼핑객들이 그 숫자가 약 1,904달러로 증가하는 것을 목격하고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why Premiums Jumped
segments.tr: ## 왜 프리미엄이 증가했는지

segments.src: The enhanced tax credits did two main things: they increased the size of subsidies for people who already qualified for help, and they extended eligibility to middle-income households that previously earned too much to receive any assistance at all.
segments.tr: 강화된 세금 공제는 두 가지 주요 작업을 수행했습니다. 기존에 도움을 받을 자격이 있는 사람들에게 보조금의 크기를 증가시키고, 이전에 보조금을 받을 수 있는 충분한 소득을 얻지 못한 중산층 가구에게 자격을 확대했습니다.

segments.src: When the enhancement expired, both of those benefits reset to pre-2021 levels.
segments.tr: 강화가 만료되면 두 가지 혜택 모두 2021년 이전 수준으로 재설정됩니다.

segments.src: For some enrollees, that means a smaller subsidy.
segments.tr: 일부 등록자에게는 더 작은 보조금을 의미합니다.

segments.src: For others — particularly those earning just above 400% of the federal poverty line — it means no subsidy at all.
segments.tr: 다른 사람들, 특히 연방 빈곤선의 400% 이상을 버는 사람들에게는 보조금이 전혀 없습니다.

segments.src: Insurers, anticipating the policy change, also filed for significant "sticker price" rate increases for 2026 plans, citing rising medical costs and the expectation that a healthier mix of subsidized customers might leave the marketplace.
segments.tr: 보험 제공업체는 정책 변경을 예상하고 2026년 계획에 대한 상당한 "스티커 가격" 금리 인상을 신청했으며, 이는 의료 비용의 상승과 보조금을 받는 고객의 더 건강한 혼합물이 시장에서 벗어나게 될 것으로 예상되기 때문입니다.

segments.src: The combination of a smaller subsidy applied to a higher base premium is what produced the sharp jump many families are now seeing on their bills.
segments.tr: 더 높은 기준 프리미엄에 더 작은 보조금을 적용하는 조합이 많은 가족이 지금 청구서에서 보는 급격한 증가를 초래했습니다.

segments.src: ## Who Is Affected
segments.tr: ## 누가 영향을 받는가

segments.src: Roughly 22 million people enrolled in ACA marketplace plans during the most recent open enrollment period, and a large majority of them received some form of premium assistance.
segments.tr: 약 2,200만 명의 사람들이 최근 개방 등록 기간 동안 ACA 시장 계획에 등록했으며, 그 중 대부분이 일부 형태의 프리미엄 보조를 받았습니다.

segments.src: Analysts who track the exchanges note that the impact is uneven:
segments.tr: 교환을 추적하는 분석가는 영향이 불균등하다고 지적합니다:

segments.src: - **Middle-income households** just above the old subsidy cutoff are seeing the steepest relative increases, since they may lose eligibility for help entirely.
segments.tr: - **중산층 가구**는 이전 보조금 제한선 바로 위에 있으며, 전적으로 보조금 자격을 잃을 수 있으므로 상대적으로 가장 큰 증가를 보이고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Older enrollees**, whose premiums are already higher due to age-rating rules, face the largest dollar increases even when their percentage increase looks similar to younger enrollees.
segments.tr: - **노인 등록자**는 나이에 따른 규칙으로 인해 이미 더 높은 프리미엄을 가지고 있으며, 퍼센트 증가가 젊은 등록자와 비슷해 보일 때에도 가장 큰 달러 증가를 겪고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers, early retirees, and gig workers** — groups with no employer-sponsored coverage option — are among the most exposed, since the marketplace is often their only source of insurance.
segments.tr: - **자영업자, 조기 은퇴자 및 프리랜서** — 고용주가 제공하는 보험 옵션이 없는 그룹 —는 시장에서 종종 그들의 유일한 보험 출처이기 때문에 가장 많이 노출됩니다.

segments.src: - **Rural enrollees**, who typically have fewer plan choices and higher benchmark premiums, are also reporting outsized increases.
segments.tr: - **농촌 등록자**는 일반적으로 계획 선택이 적고 기준 프리미엄이 더 높기 때문에 과대 증가를 보고하고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 다음은 무엇인가

segments.src: The story may not be over.
segments.tr: 이야기는 끝나지 않았을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Insurers have already signaled that 2027 filings could bring further premium growth, driven by ongoing medical inflation and continued uncertainty about the size of the subsidized enrollee pool.
segments.tr: 보험 제공업체는 이미 2027년 제출물이 의료 인플레이션의 지속과 보조금을 받는 등록자 풀의 크기에 대한 불확실성에 의해 추진되는 추가 프리미엄 성장을 가져올 수 있다고 시사했습니다.

segments.src: Consumer advocates and some lawmakers have called for Congress to revisit an extension of the enhanced credits, while others argue the program was never intended to be permanent and that a return to pre-pandemic subsidy levels restores fiscal discipline to the exchanges.
segments.tr: 소비자 옹호자와 일부 의원은 의회가 강화된 공제의 연장을 재검토하도록 촉구했으며, 다른 사람들은 프로그램이 영구적이지 않았으며 전염병 이전의 보조금 수준으로 돌아가면 교환에 재정적 규율이 회복된다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: As of now, no extension has been signed into law, and the debate is expected to continue as the next open enrollment period approaches.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 연장이 법으로 서명되지 않았으며, 다음 개방 등록 기간이 다가올 때 논의가 계속될 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do
segments.tr: ## 등록자는 무엇을 할 수 있는가

segments.src: Financial advisors and consumer groups generally recommend a few practical steps for anyone affected by the change:
segments.tr: 재정 고문과 소비자 그룹은 일반적으로 변경으로 인해 영향을 받는 모든 사람에게 몇 가지 실제 단계를 권장합니다:

segments.src: 1. **Re-shop your plan.** A lower-premium plan on the same metal tier, or a different insurer's network, may reduce costs even without a subsidy.
segments.tr: 1. **플랜을 다시 쇼핑하세요.** 동일한 금속 등급의 더 낮은 프리미엄 플랜이나 다른 보험 제공업체의 네트워크는 보조금 없이도 비용을 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Check your actual eligibility.** Subsidy formulas are based on estimated household income, and some enrollees may still qualify for partial assistance depending on their specific circumstances.
segments.tr: 2. **실제 자격을 확인하세요.** 보조금 공식은 추정된 가구 소득을 기반으로 하며, 일부 등록자는 특정 상황에 따라 부분적인 보조금을 받을 자격이 있을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Review deadlines carefully.** Marketplace enrollment windows and state-specific extensions vary, so missing a date can mean waiting months for another chance to change plans.
segments.tr: 3. **마감일을 주의해서 검토하세요.** 시장 등록 창과 주별 연장은 다르므로 날짜를 놓치면 몇 개월 동안 계획을 변경할 기회를 기다려야 할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Talk to a licensed navigator or broker.** Free enrollment assistance is available in most states and can help identify plans or cost-sharing programs that fit a specific budget.
segments.tr: 4. **면허된 내비게이터 또는 중개인과 이야기하세요.** 대부분의 주에서 무료 등록 지원이 제공되며, 특정 예산에 맞는 계획 또는 비용 공유 프로그램을 식별하는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: For personalized guidance, HealthCare.gov and state-run exchanges remain the official, authoritative source for eligibility rules, deadlines, and plan comparisons.
segments.tr: 개인화된 지침을 위해 HealthCare.gov와 주 운영 교환은 자격 규칙, 마감일 및 계획 비교에 대한 공식적이고 권위 있는 출처입니다.

segments.src: This article is intended for general informational purposes and is not a substitute for individualized financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: 이 기사는 일반 정보 제공 목적으로만 제공되며, 개인화된 재정 또는 보험 상담의 대체재는 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 더 큰 그림

segments.src: The end of the enhanced ACA subsidies is a reminder of how quickly a temporary government support program can reshape household budgets once it disappears.
segments.tr: 강화된 ACA 보조금의 종료는 임시 정부 지원 프로그램이 일단 사라지면 얼마나 빠르게 가계 예산을 재구성할 수 있는지에 대한 상기시킵니다.

segments.src: For 22 million Americans who rely on the individual marketplace, the jump from an $888 average bill to one nearing $1,904 is not an abstract policy debate — it is a real number showing up in bank statements and monthly budgets across the country.
segments.tr: 개인 시장에 의존하는 2,200만 명의 미국인에게는 평균 청구서가 888달러에서 1,904달러로 증가하는 것은 추상적인 정책 논쟁이 아닙니다. 그것은 전국의 은행 잔고와 월별 예산에 나타나는 실제 숫자입니다.

segments.src: How Washington responds in the months ahead could determine whether that gap widens further or narrows again.
segments.tr: 워싱턴이 앞으로 몇 개월 동안 어떻게 반응하는지에 따라 그 격차가 더 커지거나 다시 좁혀질 수 있습니다.

zh.title: "1,904美元的溢价：2200万美国人如何已经感受到平价医疗法案(ACA)补贴的结束"

segments.src: ## A Quiet Deadline With a Loud Impact
segments.tr: ## A Quiet Deadline With a Loud Impact

segments.src: At the stroke of midnight on December 31, 2025, a temporary but consequential piece of pandemic-era policy quietly expired.
segments.tr: 在2025年12月31日的午夜时分，一项暂时的但影响深远的疫情时期政策悄然到期。

segments.src: The enhanced premium tax credits for Affordable Care Act (ACA) marketplace plans — first introduced in 2021 and extended through 2025 — were allowed to lapse.
segments.tr: 《平价医疗法案》(ACA) 市场计划的提高版保费税收抵免——最初于2021年推出并延长至2025年——被允许失效。

segments.src: For millions of households who buy their own health insurance through HealthCare.gov or a state exchange, the change did not arrive with fanfare.
segments.tr: 对于数百万通过 HealthCare.gov 或各州交易所购买自己健康保险的家庭来说，这一改变并没有伴随着盛大的宣传。

segments.src: It arrived with a bill.
segments.tr: 它伴随着一张账单到来。

segments.src: According to marketplace enrollment data, the average annual amount enrollees paid out of pocket for coverage had been about $888 while the enhanced credits were in effect.
segments.tr: 根据市场注册数据，在提高版税收抵免生效期间，投保人自付的平均年度保费约为 $888。

segments.src: Now, with those credits gone, many shoppers are seeing that number climb toward an average of roughly $1,904 a year — more than double what they budgeted for just months earlier.
segments.tr: 现在，随着这些税收抵免的消失，许多购买者看到这个数字攀升至每年约 $1,904 左右——这比他们几个月前预算的金额高出一倍多。

segments.src: ## Why Premiums Jumped
segments.tr: ## Why Premiums Jumped

segments.src: The enhanced tax credits did two main things: they increased the size of subsidies for people who already qualified for help, and they extended eligibility to middle-income households that previously earned too much to receive any assistance at all.
segments.tr: 提高版税收抵免主要做了两件事：它们增加了已经有资格获得帮助的人的补贴金额，并将资格扩大到以前因收入过高而无法获得任何援助的中等收入家庭。

segments.src: When the enhancement expired, both of those benefits reset to pre-2021 levels.
segments.tr: 当这项增强功能到期时，这两个福利都重置回了2021年以前的水平。

segments.src: For some enrollees, that means a smaller subsidy.
segments.tr: 对一些投保人来说，这意味着更少的补贴。

segments.src: For others — particularly those earning just above 400% of the federal poverty line — it means no subsidy at all.
segments.tr: 对其他人——特别是那些收入刚超过联邦贫困线 400% 的人——这意味着完全没有补贴。

segments.src: Insurers, anticipating the policy change, also filed for significant "sticker price" rate increases for 2026 plans, citing rising medical costs and the expectation that a healthier mix of subsidized customers might leave the marketplace.
segments.tr: 保险公司在预见到这一政策变化后，也为 2026 年的计划申请了显著的“标价”费率上涨，理由是医疗成本不断上升，且预计获得补贴的较健康客户群体可能会离开市场。

segments.src: The combination of a smaller subsidy applied to a higher base premium is what produced the sharp jump many families are now seeing on their bills.
segments.tr: 较小的补贴应用于较高的基础保费，正是这种组合导致了许多家庭现在在账单上看到的急剧飙升。

segments.src: ## Who Is Affected
segments.tr: ## Who Is Affected

segments.src: Roughly 22 million people enrolled in ACA marketplace plans during the most recent open enrollment period, and a large majority of them received some form of premium assistance.
segments.tr: 在最近一次开放注册期间，大约有 2200 万人注册了 ACA 市场计划，其中绝大多数人获得了某种形式的保费援助。

segments.src: Analysts who track the exchanges note that the impact is uneven:
segments.tr: 追踪交易所的分析师指出，这种影响是不均衡的：

segments.src: - **Middle-income households** just above the old subsidy cutoff are seeing the steepest relative increases, since they may lose eligibility for help entirely.
segments.tr: - **Middle-income households** 刚过旧补贴截止线的中等收入家庭正经历着最陡峭的相对增长，因为他们可能会完全失去获得帮助的资格。

segments.src: - **Older enrollees**, whose premiums are already higher due to age-rating rules, face the largest dollar increases even when their percentage increase looks similar to younger enrollees.
segments.tr: - **Older enrollees**，由于年龄评级规则，他们的保费已经较高，即使他们的百分比增长看起来与年轻投保人相似，他们也面临着最大的美元金额增长。

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers, early retirees, and gig workers** — groups with no employer-sponsored coverage option — are among the most exposed, since the marketplace is often their only source of insurance.
segments.tr: - **Self-employed workers, early retirees, and gig workers** ——没有雇主提供保险选项的群体——是受影响最严重的群体之一，因为市场通常是他们唯一的保险来源。

segments.src: - **Rural enrollees**, who typically have fewer plan choices and higher benchmark premiums, are also reporting outsized increases.
segments.tr: - **Rural enrollees**，他们通常有较少的计划选择和更高的基准保费，也报告了超常的增长。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## What Comes Next

segments.src: The story may not be over.
segments.tr: 故事可能还没有结束。

segments.src: Insurers have already signaled that 2027 filings could bring further premium growth, driven by ongoing medical inflation and continued uncertainty about the size of the subsidized enrollee pool.
segments.tr: 保险公司已经发出信号，2027 年的申报可能会带来进一步的保费增长，这是由持续的医疗通胀以及对受补贴投保人群规模的持续不确定性所驱动的。

segments.src: Consumer advocates and some lawmakers have called for Congress to revisit an extension of the enhanced credits, while others argue the program was never intended to be permanent and that a return to pre-pandemic subsidy levels restores fiscal discipline to the exchanges.
segments.tr: 消费者倡导者和一些议员呼吁国会重新审议延长提高版税收抵免的期限，而另一些人则认为该计划从未打算成为永久性的，恢复到大流行前的补贴水平可以为交易所恢复财政纪律。

segments.src: As of now, no extension has been signed into law, and the debate is expected to continue as the next open enrollment period approaches.
segments.tr: 截至目前，还没有任何延期法案签署成为法律，随着下一个开放注册期的临近，预计辩论将继续进行。

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do
segments.tr: ## What Enrollees Can Do

segments.src: Financial advisors and consumer groups generally recommend a few practical steps for anyone affected by the change:
segments.tr: 财务顾问和消费者组织通常为受此变化影响的任何人推荐几个实际步骤：

segments.src: 1. **Re-shop your plan.** A lower-premium plan on the same metal tier, or a different insurer's network, may reduce costs even without a subsidy.
segments.tr: 1. **Re-shop your plan.** 相同金属级别下保费较低的计划，或不同保险公司的网络，甚至在没有补贴的情况下也能降低成本。

segments.src: 2. **Check your actual eligibility.** Subsidy formulas are based on estimated household income, and some enrollees may still qualify for partial assistance depending on their specific circumstances.
segments.tr: 2. **Check your actual eligibility.** 补贴公式是基于估计的家庭收入，一些投保人可能仍有资格根据其具体情况获得部分援助。

segments.src: 3. **Review deadlines carefully.** Marketplace enrollment windows and state-specific extensions vary, so missing a date can mean waiting months for another chance to change plans.

segments.src: How Washington responds in the months ahead could determine whether that gap widens further or narrows again.

hi.title: $1,904 का प्रीमियम: कैसे 2.2 करोड़ अमेरिकी पहले से ही ACA सब्सिडी के अंत को महसूस कर रहे हैं

segments.src: ## A Quiet Deadline With a Loud Impact
segments.tr: ## एक शांत समय-सीमा जिसका बड़ा प्रभाव पड़ा

segments.src: At the stroke of midnight on December 31, 2025, a temporary but consequential piece of pandemic-era policy quietly expired.
segments.tr: 31 दिसंबर, 2025 की आधी रात को, महामारी के दौर की एक अस्थायी लेकिन महत्वपूर्ण नीति चुपचाप समाप्त हो गई।

segments.src: The enhanced premium tax credits for Affordable Care Act (ACA) marketplace plans — first introduced in 2021 and extended through 2025 — were allowed to lapse.
segments.tr: अफोर्डेबल केयर एक्ट (ACA) मार्केटप्लेस योजनाओं के लिए बढ़े हुए प्रीमियम टैक्स क्रेडिट — जिन्हें पहली बार 2021 में पेश किया गया था और 2025 तक बढ़ाया गया था — को समाप्त होने दिया गया।

segments.src: For millions of households who buy their own health insurance through HealthCare.gov or a state exchange, the change did not arrive with fanfare.
segments.tr: HealthCare.gov या राज्य एक्सचेंज के माध्यम से अपना खुद का स्वास्थ्य बीमा खरीदने वाले लाखों परिवारों के लिए, यह बदलाव किसी बड़े शोर-शराबे के साथ नहीं आया।

segments.src: It arrived with a bill.
segments.tr: यह एक बिल के साथ आया।

segments.src: According to marketplace enrollment data, the average annual amount enrollees paid out of pocket for coverage had been about $888 while the enhanced credits were in effect.
segments.tr: मार्केटप्लेस नामांकन डेटा के अनुसार, बढ़े हुए क्रेडिट प्रभावी रहने के दौरान नामांकनकर्ताओं द्वारा कवरेज के लिए अपनी जेब से भुगतान की जाने वाली औसत वार्षिक राशि लगभग $888 थी।

segments.src: Now, with those credits gone, many shoppers are seeing that number climb toward an average of roughly $1,904 a year — more than double what they budgeted for just months earlier.
segments.tr: अब, उन क्रेडिट के चले जाने से, कई खरीदार देख रहे हैं कि वह संख्या बढ़कर औसतन लगभग $1,904 प्रति वर्ष हो गई है — जो कि कुछ महीने पहले के उनके बजट से दोगुने से भी अधिक है।

segments.src: ## Why Premiums Jumped
segments.tr: ## प्रीमियम क्यों बढ़े

segments.src: The enhanced tax credits did two main things: they increased the size of subsidies for people who already qualified for help, and they extended eligibility to middle-income households that previously earned too much to receive any assistance at all.
segments.tr: बढ़े हुए टैक्स क्रेडिट ने दो मुख्य काम किए: उन्होंने उन लोगों के लिए सब्सिडी का आकार बढ़ा दिया जो पहले से ही मदद के पात्र थे, और उन्होंने मध्यम आय वाले परिवारों तक पात्रता का विस्तार किया जो पहले किसी भी सहायता प्राप्त करने के लिए बहुत अधिक कमाते थे।

segments.src: When the enhancement expired, both of those benefits reset to pre-2021 levels.
segments.tr: जब यह वृद्धि समाप्त हुई, तो ये दोनों लाभ 2021 से पहले के स्तर पर वापस आ गए।

segments.src: For some enrollees, that means a smaller subsidy.
segments.tr: कुछ नामांकनकर्ताओं के लिए, इसका मतलब कम सब्सिडी है।

segments.src: For others — particularly those earning just above 400% of the federal poverty line — it means no subsidy at all.
segments.tr: दूसरों के लिए — विशेष रूप से संघीय गरीबी रेखा के 400% से ठीक ऊपर कमाने वालों के लिए — इसका मतलब कोई सब्सिडी नहीं है।

segments.src: Insurers, anticipating the policy change, also filed for significant "sticker price" rate increases for 2026 plans, citing rising medical costs and the expectation that a healthier mix of subsidized customers might leave the marketplace.
segments.tr: बीमा कंपनियों ने, नीतिगत बदलाव का अनुमान लगाते हुए, बढ़ती चिकित्सा लागतों और इस उम्मीद का हवाला देते हुए कि सब्सिडी वाले स्वस्थ ग्राहकों का एक वर्ग मार्केटप्लेस छोड़ सकता है, 2026 की योजनाओं के लिए महत्वपूर्ण "स्टिकर मूल्य" दरों में वृद्धि के लिए भी आवेदन किया।

segments.src: The combination of a smaller subsidy applied to a higher base premium is what produced the sharp jump many families are now seeing on their bills.
segments.tr: उच्च आधार प्रीमियम पर लागू होने वाली कम सब्सिडी के संयोजन ने ही वह तीव्र उछाल पैदा किया है जिसे कई परिवार अब अपने बिलों पर देख रहे हैं।

segments.src: ## Who Is Affected
segments.tr: ## कौन प्रभावित है

segments.src: Roughly 22 million people enrolled in ACA marketplace plans during the most recent open enrollment period, and a large majority of them received some form of premium assistance.
segments.tr: सबसे हालिया खुली नामांकन अवधि के दौरान लगभग 2.2 करोड़ लोगों ने ACA मार्केटप्लेस योजनाओं में नामांकन कराया, और उनमें से एक बड़े बहुमत को किसी न किसी रूप में प्रीमियम सहायता प्राप्त हुई।

segments.src: Analysts who track the exchanges note that the impact is uneven:
segments.tr: एक्सचेंजों पर नज़र रखने वाले विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि इसका प्रभाव असमान है:

segments.src: - **Middle-income households** just above the old subsidy cutoff are seeing the steepest relative increases, since they may lose eligibility for help entirely.
segments.tr: - **मध्यम आय वाले परिवार** जो पुरानी सब्सिडी सीमा से ठीक ऊपर हैं, वे सबसे तीव्र सापेक्ष वृद्धि देख रहे हैं, क्योंकि वे पूरी तरह से सहायता के लिए पात्रता खो सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Older enrollees**, whose premiums are already higher due to age-rating rules, face the largest dollar increases even when their percentage increase looks similar to younger enrollees.
segments.tr: - **अधिक उम्र के नामांकनकर्ता**, जिनके प्रीमियम आयु-रेटिंग नियमों के कारण पहले से ही अधिक हैं, उन्हें सबसे बड़ी डॉलर वृद्धि का सामना करना पड़ रहा है, भले ही उनकी प्रतिशत वृद्धि युवा नामांकनकर्ताओं के समान दिखती हो।

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers, early retirees, and gig workers** — groups with no employer-sponsored coverage option — are among the most exposed, since the marketplace is often their only source of insurance.
segments.tr: - **स्व-नियोजित कर्मचारी, जल्दी सेवानिवृत्त होने वाले लोग, और गिग वर्कर्स** — ऐसे समूह जिनके पास नियोक्ता-प्रायोजित कवरेज का कोई विकल्प नहीं है — सबसे अधिक प्रभावित होने वालों में से हैं, क्योंकि मार्केटप्लेस अक्सर उनके बीमा का एकमात्र स्रोत होता है।

segments.src: - **Rural enrollees**, who typically have fewer plan choices and higher benchmark premiums, are also reporting outsized increases.
segments.tr: - **ग्रामीण नामांकनकर्ता**, जिनके पास आमतौर पर कम योजना विकल्प और उच्च बेंचमार्क प्रीमियम होते हैं, वे भी अत्यधिक वृद्धि की रिपोर्ट कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: The story may not be over.
segments.tr: कहानी अभी खत्म नहीं हुई होगी।

segments.src: Insurers have already signaled that 2027 filings could bring further premium growth, driven by ongoing medical inflation and continued uncertainty about the size of the subsidized enrollee pool.
segments.tr: बीमा कंपनियों ने पहले ही संकेत दे दिया है कि 2027 के आवेदनों में निरंतर चिकित्सा मुद्रास्फीति और सब्सिडी वाले नामांकनकर्ताओं के पूल के आकार के बारे में निरंतर अनिश्चितता के कारण प्रीमियम में और वृद्धि हो सकती है।

segments.src: Consumer advocates and some lawmakers have called for Congress to revisit an extension of the enhanced credits, while others argue the program was never intended to be permanent and that a return to pre-pandemic subsidy levels restores fiscal discipline to the exchanges.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ता अधिवक्ताओं और कुछ सांसदों ने कांग्रेस से बढ़े हुए क्रेडिट के विस्तार पर फिर से विचार करने का आह्वान किया है, जबकि अन्य का तर्क है कि इस कार्यक्रम का उद्देश्य कभी भी स्थायी होना नहीं था और महामारी से पहले के सब्सिडी स्तरों पर लौटने से एक्सचेंजों में राजकोषीय अनुशासन बहाल होता है।

segments.src: As of now, no extension has been signed into law, and the debate is expected to continue as the next open enrollment period approaches.
segments.tr: अभी तक, किसी भी विस्तार को कानून के रूप में हस्ताक्षरित नहीं किया गया है, और अगली खुली नामांकन अवधि के करीब आने पर बहस जारी रहने की उम्मीद है।

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do
segments.tr: ## नामांकनकर्ता क्या कर सकते हैं

segments.src: Financial advisors and consumer groups generally recommend a few practical steps for anyone affected by the change:
segments.tr: वित्तीय सलाहकार और उपभोक्ता समूह आम तौर पर इस बदलाव से प्रभावित किसी भी व्यक्ति के लिए कुछ व्यावहारिक कदमों की सिफारिश करते हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Re-shop your plan.** A lower-premium plan on the same metal tier, or a different insurer's network, may reduce costs even without a subsidy.
segments.tr: 1. **अपनी योजना की फिर से तुलना करें।** उसी मेटल टियर पर कम-प्रीमियम वाली योजना, या किसी अन्य बीमाकर्ता का नेटवर्क, बिना सब्सिडी के भी लागत को कम कर सकता है।

segments.src: 2. **Check your actual eligibility.** Subsidy formulas are based on estimated household income, and some enrollees may still qualify for partial assistance depending on their specific circumstances.
segments.tr: 2. **अपनी वास्तविक पात्रता की जांच करें।** सब्सिडी के सूत्र अनुमानित घरेलू आय पर आधारित होते हैं, और कुछ नामांकनकर्ता अपनी विशिष्ट परिस्थितियों के आधार पर अभी भी आंशिक सहायता के लिए पात्र हो सकते moths।

segments.src: 3. **Review deadlines carefully.** Marketplace enrollment windows and state-specific extensions vary, so missing a date can mean waiting months for another chance to change plans.
segments.tr: 3. **समय-सीमाओं की सावधानीपूर्वक समीक्षा करें।** मार्केटप्लेस नामांकन अवधि और राज्य-विशिष्ट विस्तार अलग-अलग होते हैं, इसलिए किसी तारीख को चूकने का मतलब योजनाओं को बदलने के दूसरे अवसर के लिए महीनों इंतजार करना हो सकता है।

segments.src: 4. **Talk to a licensed navigator or broker.** Free enrollment assistance is available in most states and can help identify plans or cost-sharing programs that fit a specific budget.
segments.tr: 4. **लाइसेंस प्राप्त नेविगेटर या ब्रोकर से बात करें।** अधिकांश राज्यों में मुफ्त नामांकन सहायता उपलब्ध है और यह उन योजनाओं या लागत-साझाकरण कार्यक्रमों की पहचान करने में मदद कर सकती है जो एक विशिष्ट बजट में फिट होते हैं।

segments.src: For personalized guidance, HealthCare.gov and state-run exchanges remain the official, authoritative source for eligibility rules, deadlines, and plan comparisons.
segments.tr: व्यक्तिगत मार्गदर्शन के लिए, HealthCare.gov और राज्य-संचालित एक्सचेंज पात्रता नियमों, समय-सीमाओं और योजना तुलनाओं के लिए आधिकारिक, आधिकारिक स्रोत बने हुए हैं।

segments.src: This article is intended for general informational purposes and is not a substitute for individualized financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: यह लेख सामान्य सूचनात्मक उद्देश्यों के लिए है और व्यक्तिगत वित्तीय या बीमा सलाह का विकल्प नहीं है।

segments.tr: ## बड़ी तस्वीर

segments.src: The end of the enhanced ACA subsidies is a reminder of how quickly a temporary government support program can reshape household budgets once it disappears.
segments.tr: बढ़ी हुई ACA सब्सिडी का अंत इस बात की याद दिलाता है कि एक अस्थायी सरकारी सहायता कार्यक्रम गायब होने के बाद कितनी जल्दी घरेलू बजट को नया आकार दे सकता है।

segments.src: For 22 million Americans who rely on the individual marketplace, the jump from an $888 average bill to one nearing $1,904 is not an abstract policy debate — it is a real number showing up in bank statements and monthly budgets across the country.
segments.tr: व्यक्तिगत मार्केटप्लेस पर निर्भर रहने वाले 2.2 करोड़ अमेरिकियों के लिए, $888 के औसत बिल से बढ़कर $1,904 के करीब पहुंचना कोई अमूर्त नीतिगत बहस नहीं है — यह एक वास्तविक संख्या है जो देश भर में बैंक स्टेटमेंट और मासिक बजट में दिखाई दे रही है।

segments.src: How Washington responds in the months ahead could determine whether that gap widens further or narrows again.
segments.tr: आने वाले महीनों में वाशिंगटन की प्रतिक्रिया यह तय कर सकती है कि वह अंतर और चौड़ा होगा या फिर से कम होगा।

segments.tr: ## Por qué aumentaron las primas

segments.src: The enhanced tax credits did two main things: they increased the size of subsidies for people who already qualified for help, and they extended eligibility to middle-income households that previously earned too much to receive any assistance at all.
segments.tr: Los créditos fiscales mejorados hicieron dos cosas principales: aumentaron el tamaño de los subsidios para las personas que ya calificaban para recibir ayuda, y extendieron la elegibilidad a los hogares de ingresos medios que anteriormente ganaban demasiado para recibir cualquier tipo de asistencia.

segments.src: When the enhancement expired, both of those benefits reset to pre-2021 levels.
segments.tr: Cuando la mejora expiró, ambos beneficios se restablecieron a los niveles anteriores a 2021.

segments.src: For some enrollees, that means a smaller subsidy.
segments.tr: Para algunos inscritos, eso significa un subsidio menor.

segments.src: For others — particularly those earning just above 400% of the federal poverty line — it means no subsidy at all.
segments.tr: Para otros, particularmente aquellos que ganan justo por encima del 400% del nivel federal de pobreza, significa no recibir ningún subsidio.

segments.src: Insurers, anticipating the policy change, also filed for significant "sticker price" rate increases for 2026 plans, citing rising medical costs and the expectation that a healthier mix of subsidized customers might leave the marketplace.
segments.tr: Las aseguradoras, anticipando el cambio de política, también solicitaron aumentos significativos en las tarifas de "precio de etiqueta" para los planes de 2026, citando el aumento de los costos médicos y la expectativa de que una combinación más saludable de clientes subsidiados podría abandonar el mercado.

segments.src: The combination of a smaller subsidy applied to a higher base premium is what produced the sharp jump many families are now seeing on their bills.
segments.tr: La combinación de un subsidio menor aplicado a una prima base más alta es lo que produjo el fuerte salto que muchas familias están viendo ahora en sus facturas.

segments.src: ## Who Is Affected
segments.tr: ## Quiénes se ven afectados

segments.src: Roughly 22 million people enrolled in ACA marketplace plans during the most recent open enrollment period, and a large majority of them received some form of premium assistance.
segments.tr: Aproximadamente 22 millones de personas se inscribieron en planes del mercado de la ACA durante el período de inscripción abierta más reciente, y una gran mayoría de ellos recibió algún tipo de asistencia para las primas.

segments.src: Analysts who track the exchanges note that the impact is uneven:
segments.tr: Los analistas que rastrean los mercados señalan que el impacto es desigual:

segments.src: - **Middle-income households** just above the old subsidy cutoff are seeing the steepest relative increases, since they may lose eligibility for help entirely.
segments.tr: - **Los hogares de ingresos medios** justo por encima del antiguo límite de subsidio están viendo los aumentos relativos más pronunciados, ya que pueden perder por completo la elegibilidad para recibir ayuda.

segments.src: - **Older enrollees**, whose premiums are already higher due to age-rating rules, face the largest dollar increases even when their percentage increase looks similar to younger enrollees.
segments.tr: - **Los inscritos de mayor edad**, cuyas primas ya son más altas debido a las reglas de calificación por edad, enfrentan los mayores aumentos en dólares, incluso cuando su aumento porcentual parece similar al de los inscritos más jóvenes.

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers, early retirees, and gig workers** — groups with no employer-sponsored coverage option — are among the most exposed, since the marketplace is often their only source of insurance.
segments.tr: - **Los trabajadores autónomos, los jubilados anticipados y los trabajadores de la economía colaborativa (gig workers)**, grupos sin opción de cobertura patrocinada por el empleador, se encuentran entre los más expuestos, ya que el mercado suele ser su única fuente de seguro.

segments.src: - **Rural enrollees**, who typically have fewer plan choices and higher benchmark premiums, are also reporting outsized increases.
segments.tr: - **Los inscritos en zonas rurales**, que generalmente tienen menos opciones de planes y primas de referencia más altas, también están reportando aumentos desproporcionados.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Qué sigue

segments.src: The story may not be over.
segments.tr: Es posible que la historia no haya terminado.

segments.src: Insurers have already signaled that 2027 filings could bring further premium growth, driven by ongoing medical inflation and continued uncertainty about the size of the subsidized enrollee pool.
segments.tr: Las aseguradoras ya han señalado que las presentaciones para 2027 podrían traer un mayor crecimiento de las primas, impulsado por la inflación médica continua y la incertidumbre persistente sobre el tamaño del grupo de inscritos subsidiados.

segments.src: Consumer advocates and some lawmakers have called for Congress to revisit an extension of the enhanced credits, while others argue the program was never intended to be permanent and that a return to pre-pandemic subsidy levels restores fiscal discipline to the exchanges.
segments.tr: Los defensores de los consumidores y algunos legisladores han pedido al Congreso que reconsidere una extensión de los créditos mejorados, mientras que otros argumentan que el programa nunca tuvo la intención de ser permanente y que un retorno a los niveles de subsidio previos a la pandemia restaura la disciplina fiscal en los mercados.

segments.src: As of now, no extension has been signed into law, and the debate is expected to continue as the next open enrollment period approaches.
segments.tr: Hasta ahora, no se ha promulgado ninguna extensión, y se espera que el debate continúe a medida que se acerca el próximo período de inscripción abierta.

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do
segments.tr: ## Qué pueden hacer los inscritos

segments.src: Financial advisors and consumer groups generally recommend a few practical steps for anyone affected by the change:
segments.tr: Los asesores financieros y los grupos de consumidores generalmente recomiendan algunos pasos prácticos para cualquier persona afectada por el cambio:

segments.src: 1. **Re-shop your plan.** A lower-premium plan on the same metal tier, or a different insurer's network, may reduce costs even without a subsidy.
segments.tr: 1. **Vuelva a buscar su plan.** Un plan con una prima más baja en el mismo nivel de metal, o la red de otra aseguradora, puede reducir los costos incluso sin un subsidio.

segments.src: 2. **Check your actual eligibility.** Subsidy formulas are based on estimated household income, and some enrollees may still qualify for partial assistance depending on their specific circumstances.
segments.tr: 2. **Verifique su elegibilidad real.** Las fórmulas de subsidio se basan en el ingreso familiar estimado, y algunos inscritos aún pueden calificar para una asistencia parcial dependiendo de sus circunstancias específicas.

segments.src: 3. **Review deadlines carefully.** Marketplace enrollment windows and state-specific extensions vary, so missing a date can mean waiting months for another chance to change plans.
segments.tr: 3. **Revise cuidadosamente las fechas límite.** Las ventanas de inscripción al mercado y las extensiones específicas de cada estado varían, por lo que perder una fecha puede significar esperar meses para tener otra oportunidad de cambiar de plan.

segments.src: 4. **Talk to a licensed navigator or broker.** Free enrollment assistance is available in most states and can help identify plans or cost-sharing programs that fit a specific budget.
segments.tr: 4. **Hable con un navegador o agente con licencia.** La asistencia gratuita para la inscripción está disponible en la mayoría de los estados y puede ayudar a identificar planes o programas de costos compartidos que se ajusten a un presupuesto específico.

segments.src: For personalized guidance, HealthCare.gov and state-run exchanges remain the official, authoritative source for eligibility rules, deadlines, and plan comparisons.
segments.tr: Para obtener orientación personalizada, HealthCare.gov y los mercados administrados por el estado siguen siendo la fuente oficial y autorizada para las reglas de elegibilidad, las fechas límite y las comparaciones de planes.

segments.src: This article is intended for general informational purposes and is not a substitute for individualized financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: Este artículo tiene fines informativos generales y no sustituye el asesoramiento financiero o de seguros individualizado.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## El panorama general

segments.src: The end of the enhanced ACA subsidies is a reminder of how quickly a temporary government support program can reshape household budgets once it disappears.
segments.tr: El fin de los subsidios mejorados de la ACA es un recordatorio de cuán rápido un programa temporal de apoyo gubernamental puede remodelar los presupuestos familiares una vez que desaparece.

segments.src: For 22 million Americans who rely on the individual marketplace, the jump from an $888 average bill to one nearing $1,904 is not an abstract policy debate — it is a real number showing up in bank statements and monthly budgets across the country.
segments.tr: Para los 22 millones de estadounidenses que dependen del mercado individual, el salto de una factura promedio de $888 a una que se acerca a los $1,904 no es un debate político abstracto: es una cifra real que aparece en los estados de cuenta bancarios y en los presupuestos mensuales en todo el país.

segments.src: How Washington responds in the months ahead could determine whether that gap widens further or narrows again.
segments.tr: Cómo responda Washington en los próximos meses podría determinar si esa brecha se amplía aún más o se reduce nuevamente.

segments.src: ## A Quiet Deadline With a Loud Impact
segments.tr: ## موعد نهائي هادئ ذو تأثير مدوٍ

segments.src: At the stroke of midnight on December 31, 2025, a temporary but consequential piece of pandemic-era policy quietly expired.
segments.tr: عند منتصف الليل في 31 ديسمبر 2025، انتهت صلاحية سياسة مؤقتة ولكنها ذات عواقب وخيمة من حقبة الجائحة بهدوء.

segments.src: The enhanced premium tax credits for Affordable Care Act (ACA) marketplace plans — first introduced in 2021 and extended through 2025 — were allowed to lapse.
segments.tr: حيث سُمح بانتهاء صلاحية الإعفاءات الضريبية المعززة لأقساط التأمين لخطط سوق قانون الرعاية الميسرة (ACA) — والتي تم تقديمها لأول مرة في عام 2021 وتم تمديدها حتى عام 2025.

segments.src: For millions of households who buy their own health insurance through HealthCare.gov or a state exchange, the change did not arrive with fanfare.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لملايين الأسر التي تشتري تأمينها الصحي الخاص من خلال موقع HealthCare.gov أو بورصة الولاية، لم يأتِ هذا التغيير بضجة كبيرة.

segments.src: It arrived with a bill.
segments.tr: بل جاء مصحوبًا بفاتورة.

segments.src: According to marketplace enrollment data, the average annual amount enrollees paid out of pocket for coverage had been about $888 while the enhanced credits were in effect.
segments.tr: وفقًا لبيانات التسجيل في السوق، كان متوسط المبلغ السنوي الذي يدفعه المسجلون من جيوبهم الخاصة للتغطية حوالي $888 أثناء سريان الإعفاءات المعززة.

segments.src: Now, with those credits gone, many shoppers are seeing that number climb toward an average of roughly $1,904 a year — more than double what they budgeted for just months earlier.
segments.tr: الآن، ومع زوال تلك الإعفاءات، يرى العديد من المتسوقين أن هذا الرقم يرتفع نحو متوسط يقارب $1,904 سنويًا — وهو أكثر من ضعف ما خصصوه في ميزانيتهم قبل أشهر فقط.

segments.src: ## Why Premiums Jumped
segments.tr: ## لماذا قفزت أقساط التأمين

segments.src: The enhanced tax credits did two main things: they increased the size of subsidies for people who already qualified for help, and they extended eligibility to middle-income households that previously earned too much to receive any assistance at all.
segments.tr: لقد حققت الإعفاءات الضريبية المعززة أمرين رئيسيين: فقد زادت من حجم الدعم للأشخاص الذين تأهلوا بالفعل للحصول على المساعدة، ووسعت نطاق الأهلية ليشمل الأسر ذات الدخل المتوسط التي كانت تكسب في السابق أكثر من اللازم لتلقي أي مساعدة على الإطلاق.

segments.src: When the enhancement expired, both of those benefits reset to pre-2021 levels.
segments.tr: وعندما انتهت صلاحية هذا التعزيز، عادت هاتان الميزتان إلى مستويات ما قبل عام 2021.

segments.src: For some enrollees, that means a smaller subsidy.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لبعض المسجلين، يعني ذلك دعمًا أصغر.

segments.src: For others — particularly those earning just above 400% of the federal poverty line — it means no subsidy at all.
segments.tr: وبالنسبة لآخرين — وخاصة أولئك الذين يكسبون ما يزيد قليلاً عن 400% من خط الفقر الفيدرالي — فإن ذلك يعني عدم وجود دعم على الإطلاق.

segments.src: Insurers, anticipating the policy change, also filed for significant "sticker price" rate increases for 2026 plans, citing rising medical costs and the expectation that a healthier mix of subsidized customers might leave the marketplace.
segments.tr: كما تقدمت شركات التأمين، تحسبًا لتغيير السياسة، بطلبات لزيادة كبيرة في أسعار "الملصقات المعلنة" لخطط عام 2026، مستشهدة بارتفاع التكاليف الطبية والتوقعات بأن مزيجًا أكثر صحة من العملاء المدعومين قد يغادر السوق.

segments.src: The combination of a smaller subsidy applied to a higher base premium is what produced the sharp jump many families are now seeing on their bills.
segments.tr: إن الجمع بين دعم أصغر مطبق على قسط أساسي أعلى هو ما أدى إلى القفزة الحادة التي تراها العديد من العائلات الآن في فواتيرها.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## ماذا سيحدث بعد ذلك

segments.src: The story may not be over.
segments.tr: قد لا تكون القصة قد انتهت بعد.

segments.src: Insurers have already signaled that 2027 filings could bring further premium growth, driven by ongoing medical inflation and continued uncertainty about the size of the subsidized enrollee pool.
segments.tr: فقد أشارت شركات التأمين بالفعل إلى أن طلبات عام 2027 قد تجلب المزيد من النمو في أقساط التأمين، مدفوعة بالتضخم الطبي المستمر وعدم اليقين المستمر بشأن حجم مجموعة المسجلين المدعومين.

segments.src: Consumer advocates and some lawmakers have called for Congress to revisit an extension of the enhanced credits, while others argue the program was never intended to be permanent and that a return to pre-pandemic subsidy levels restores fiscal discipline to the exchanges.
segments.tr: وقد دعا المدافعون عن المستهلك وبعض المشرعين الكونجرس إلى إعادة النظر في تمديد الإعفاءات المعززة، بينما يرى آخرون أن البرنامج لم يكن مقصودًا منه أبدًا أن يكون دائمًا وأن العودة إلى مستويات الدعم قبل الجائحة تعيد الانضباط المالي إلى البورصات.

segments.src: When the enhancement expired, both of those benefits reset to pre-2021 levels.
segments.tr: Lorsque la bonification a expiré, ces deux avantages sont revenus aux niveaux d'avant 2021.

segments.src: For some enrollees, that means a smaller subsidy.
segments.tr: Pour certains assurés, cela signifie une subvention plus faible.

segments.src: For others — particularly those earning just above 400% of the federal poverty line — it means no subsidy at all.
segments.tr: Pour d'autres — en particulier ceux qui gagnent un peu plus de 400 % du seuil de pauvreté fédéral —, cela signifie aucune subvention du tout.

segments.src: Insurers, anticipating the policy change, also filed for significant "sticker price" rate increases for 2026 plans, citing rising medical costs and the expectation that a healthier mix of subsidized customers might leave the marketplace.
segments.tr: Les assureurs, anticipant le changement de politique, ont également demandé des augmentations de tarifs significatives sous forme de « prix affichés » pour les régimes de 2026, invoquant la hausse des coûts médicaux et l'attente qu'un mélange plus sain de clients subventionnés puisse quitter le marché.

segments.src: The combination of a smaller subsidy applied to a higher base premium is what produced the sharp jump many families are now seeing on their bills.
segments.tr: La combinaison d'une subvention plus faible appliquée à une prime de base plus élevée est ce qui a produit la forte hausse que de nombreux foyers constatent désormais sur leurs factures.

segments.src: ## Who Is Affected
segments.tr: ## Qui est touché

segments.src: Roughly 22 million people enrolled in ACA marketplace plans during the most recent open enrollment period, and a large majority of them received some form of premium assistance.
segments.tr: Environ 22 millions de personnes se sont inscrites aux régimes de la place de marché de l'ACA au cours de la période d'inscription ouverte la plus récente, et une grande majorité d'entre elles ont reçu une forme d'aide sur les primes.

segments.src: Analysts who track the exchanges note that the impact is uneven:
segments.tr: Les analystes qui suivent les bourses notent que l'impact est inégal :

segments.src: - **Middle-income households** just above the old subsidy cutoff are seeing the steepest relative increases, since they may lose eligibility for help entirely.
segments.tr: - **Les ménages à revenu moyen** situés juste au-dessus de l'ancien seuil de subvention subissent les augmentations relatives les plus fortes, car ils risquent de perdre entièrement leur admissibilité à l'aide.

segments.src: - **Older enrollees**, whose premiums are already higher due to age-rating rules, face the largest dollar increases even when their percentage increase looks similar to younger enrollees.
segments.tr: - **Les assurés plus âgés**, dont les primes sont déjà plus élevées en raison des règles de tarification fondées sur l'âge, font face aux plus fortes augmentations en dollars, même lorsque leur augmentation en pourcentage semble similaire à celle des assurés plus jeunes.

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers, early retirees, and gig workers** — groups with no employer-sponsored coverage option — are among the most exposed, since the marketplace is often their only source of insurance.
segments.tr: - **Les travailleurs autonomes, les retraités anticipés et les travailleurs de plateformes** — des groupes qui n'ont pas d'option de couverture par l'employeur — figurent parmi les plus exposés, la place de marché étant souvent leur seule source d'assurance.

segments.src: - **Rural enrollees**, who typically have fewer plan choices and higher benchmark premiums, are also reporting outsized increases.
segments.tr: - **Les assurés ruraux**, qui ont généralement moins de choix de régimes et des primes de référence plus élevées, signalent également des augmentations disproportionnées.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Quelle est la suite

segments.src: The story may not be over.
segments.tr: L'histoire n'est peut-être pas terminée.

segments.src: Insurers have already signaled that 2027 filings could bring further premium growth, driven by ongoing medical inflation and continued uncertainty about the size of the subsidized enrollee pool.
segments.tr: Les assureurs ont déjà laissé entendre que les dossiers pour 2027 pourraient entraîner une nouvelle hausse des primes, poussée par l'inflation médicale en cours et l'incertitude persistante quant à la taille du bassin d'assurés subventionnés.

segments.src: Consumer advocates and some lawmakers have called for Congress to revisit an extension of the enhanced credits, while others argue the program was never intended to be permanent and that a return to pre-pandemic subsidy levels restores fiscal discipline to the exchanges.
segments.tr: Des défenseurs des consommateurs et certains législateurs ont demandé au Congrès de réexaminer une prolongation des crédits bonifiés, tandis que d'autres soutiennent que le programme n'a jamais eu vocation à être permanent et qu'un retour aux niveaux de subvention d'avant la pandémie rétablit la discipline budgétaire au sein des bourses.

segments.src: As of now, no extension has been signed into law, and the debate is expected to continue as the next open enrollment period approaches.
segments.tr: À l'heure actuelle, aucune prolongation n'a été promulguée, et le débat devrait se poursuivre à l'approche de la prochaine période d'inscription ouverte.

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do
segments.tr: ## Que peuvent faire les assurés

segments.src: Financial advisors and consumer groups generally recommend a few practical steps for anyone affected by the change:
segments.tr: Les conseillers financiers et les groupes de consommateurs recommandent généralement quelques mesures pratiques à toute personne touchée par le changement :

segments.src: 1. **Re-shop your plan.** A lower-premium plan on the same metal tier, or a different insurer's network, may reduce costs even without a subsidy.
segments.tr: 1. **Recherchez un nouveau régime.** Un régime à prime moins élevée dans la même catégorie de métaux, ou le réseau d'un autre assureur, peut réduire les coûts même sans subvention.

segments.src: 2. **Check your actual eligibility.** Subsidy formulas are based on estimated household income, and some enrollees may still qualify for partial assistance depending on their specific circumstances.
segments.tr: 2. **Vérifiez votre admissibilité réelle.** Les formules de subvention sont basées sur le revenu estimé du ménage, et certains assurés peuvent toujours être admissibles à une aide partielle selon leur situation particulière.

segments.src: 3. **Review deadlines carefully.** Marketplace enrollment windows and state-specific extensions vary, so missing a date can mean waiting months for another chance to change plans.
segments.tr: 3. **Examinez attentivement les dates limites.** Les fenêtres d'inscription au marché et les prolongations propres aux États varient, de sorte qu'manquer une date peut signifier attendre des mois pour une autre chance de changer de régime.

segments.src: 4. **Talk to a licensed navigator or broker.** Free enrollment assistance is available in most states and can help identify plans or cost-sharing programs that fit a specific budget.
segments.tr: 4. **Parlez à un navigateur ou à un courtier agréé.** Une aide à l'inscription gratuite est disponible dans la plupart des États et peut aider à identifier des régimes ou des programmes de partage des coûts qui conviennent à un budget précis.

segments.src: For personalized guidance, HealthCare.gov and state-run exchanges remain the official, authoritative source for eligibility rules, deadlines, and plan comparisons.
segments.tr: Pour des conseils personnalisés, HealthCare.gov et les bourses gérées par les États restent la source officielle et faisant autorité pour les règles d'admissibilité, les dates limites et les comparaisons de régimes.

segments.src: This article is intended for general informational purposes and is not a substitute for individualized financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: Cet article est destiné à des fins d'information générale et ne remplace pas un conseil financier ou d'assurance personnalisé.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## La vue d'ensemble

segments.src: The end of the enhanced ACA subsidies is a reminder of how quickly a temporary government support program can reshape household budgets once it disappears.
segments.tr: La fin des subventions bonifiées de l'ACA rappelle à quel point un programme de soutien gouvernemental temporaire peut rapidement remodeler les budgets des ménages une fois qu'il disparaît.

segments.src: For 22 million Americans who rely on the individual marketplace, the jump from an $888 average bill to one nearing $1,904 is not an abstract policy debate — it is a real number showing up in bank statements and monthly budgets across the country.
segments.tr: Pour les 22 millions d'Américains qui comptent sur la place de marché individuelle, le saut d'une facture moyenne de 888 $ à une facture avoisinant 1 904 $ n'est pas un débat politique abstrait — c'est un chiffre bien réel qui apparaît sur les relevés bancaires et les budgets mensuels à travers le pays.

segments.src: How Washington responds in the months ahead could determine whether that gap widens further or narrows again.
segments.tr: La manière dont Washington réagira dans les mois à venir pourrait déterminer si cet écart se creuse davantage ou se réduit à nouveau.

pt.title: O Aumento de $1.904: Como 22 Milhões de Americanos Já Estão Sentindo o Fim dos Subsídios do ACA

segments.src: ## A Quiet Deadline With a Loud Impact
segments.tr: ## Um Prazo Silencioso com um Impacto Estrondoso

segments.src: At the stroke of midnight on December 31, 2025, a temporary but consequential piece of pandemic-era policy quietly expired.
segments.tr: À meia-noite de 31 de dezembro de 2025, uma medida temporária, mas importante, da política da era da pandemia expirou silenciosamente.

segments.src: The enhanced premium tax credits for Affordable Care Act (ACA) marketplace plans — first introduced in 2021 and extended through 2025 — were allowed to lapse.
segments.tr: Os créditos fiscais de prêmio aprimorados para os planos do mercado do Affordable Care Act (ACA) — introduzidos pela primeira vez em 2021 e estendidos até 2025 — foram deixados expirar.

segments.src: For millions of households who buy their own health insurance through HealthCare.gov or a state exchange, the change did not arrive with fanfare.
segments.tr: Para milhões de famílias que compram seu próprio seguro saúde através do HealthCare.gov ou de um mercado estadual, a mudança não veio com alarde.

segments.src: It arrived with a bill.
segments.tr: Veio com uma conta.

segments.src: According to marketplace enrollment data, the average annual amount enrollees paid out of pocket for coverage had been about $888 while the enhanced credits were in effect.
segments.tr: De acordo com os dados de inscrição no mercado, o valor anual médio que os inscritos pagavam do próprio bolso pela cobertura era de cerca de $888 enquanto os créditos aprimorados estavam em vigor.

segments.src: Now, with those credits gone, many shoppers are seeing that number climb toward an average of roughly $1,904 a year — more than double what they budgeted for just months earlier.
segments.tr: Agora, com o fim desses créditos, muitos compradores estão vendo esse número subir para uma média de aproximadamente $1.904 por ano — mais do que o dobro do que haviam orçado apenas alguns meses antes.

segments.src: ## Why Premiums Jumped
segments.tr: ## Por que os Prêmios Aumentaram

segments.src: The enhanced tax credits did two main things: they increased the size of subsidies for people who already qualified for help, and they extended eligibility to middle-income households that previously earned too much to receive any assistance at all.
segments.tr: Os créditos fiscais aprimorados fizeram duas coisas principais: aumentaram o tamanho dos subsídios para pessoas que já se qualificavam para ajuda e estenderam a elegibilidade para famílias de renda média que anteriormente ganhavam demais para receber qualquer assistência.

segments.src: When the enhancement expired, both of those benefits reset to pre-2021 levels.
segments.tr: Quando o aprimoramento expirou, ambos os benefícios retornaram aos níveis anteriores a 2021.

segments.src: For some enrollees, that means a smaller subsidy.
segments.tr: Para alguns inscritos, isso significa um subsídio menor.

segments.src: For others — particularly those earning just above 400% of the federal poverty line — it means no subsidy at all.
segments.tr: Para outros — particularmente aqueles que ganham pouco acima de 400% da linha federal de pobreza — significa nenhum subsídio.

segments.src: Insurers, anticipating the policy change, also filed for significant "sticker price" rate increases for 2026 plans, citing rising medical costs and the expectation that a healthier mix of subsidized customers might leave the marketplace.
segments.tr: As seguradoras, antecipando a mudança na política, também solicitaram aumentos significativos nas "tabelas de preços" para os planos de 2026, citando o aumento dos custos médicos e a expectativa de que uma combinação mais saudável de clientes subsidiados pudesse deixar o mercado.

segments.src: The combination of a smaller subsidy applied to a higher base premium is what produced the sharp jump many families are now seeing on their bills.
segments.tr: A combinação de um subsídio menor aplicado a um prêmio base mais alto é o que produziu o salto acentuado que muitas famílias estão vendo agora em suas contas.

segments.src: ## Who Is Affected
segments.tr: ## Quem é Afetado

segments.src: Roughly 22 million people enrolled in ACA marketplace plans during the most recent open enrollment period, and a large majority of them received some form of premium assistance.
segments.tr: Cerca de 22 milhões de pessoas se inscreveram nos planos do mercado do ACA durante o período de inscrição aberta mais recente, e a grande maioria delas recebeu alguma forma de assistência com o prêmio.

segments.src: Analysts who track the exchanges note that the impact is uneven:
segments.tr: Analistas que acompanham os mercados observam que o impacto é desigual:

segments.src: - **Middle-income households** just above the old subsidy cutoff are seeing the steepest relative increases, since they may lose eligibility for help entirely.
segments.tr: - **Famílias de renda média** logo acima do antigo limite de subsídio estão vendo os aumentos relativos mais acentuados, já que podem perder totalmente a elegibilidade para ajuda.

segments.src: - **Older enrollees**, whose premiums are already higher due to age-rating rules, face the largest dollar increases even when their percentage increase looks similar to younger enrollees.
segments.tr: - **Inscritos mais velhos**, cujos prêmios já são mais altos devido às regras de classificação por idade, enfrentam os maiores aumentos em dólares, mesmo quando o aumento percentual parece semelhante ao dos inscritos mais jovens.

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers, early retirees, and gig workers** — groups with no employer-sponsored coverage option — are among the most exposed, since the marketplace is often their only source of insurance.
segments.tr: - **Trabalhadores autônomos, aposentados precoces e trabalhadores de aplicativos** — grupos sem opção de cobertura patrocinada pelo empregador — estão entre os mais expostos, já que o mercado é frequentemente sua única fonte de seguro.

segments.src: - **Rural enrollees**, who typically have fewer plan choices and higher benchmark premiums, are also reporting outsized increases.
segments.tr: - **Inscritos em áreas rurais**, que normalmente têm menos opções de planos e prêmios de referência mais altos, também estão relatando aumentos desproporcionais.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Vem a Seguir

segments.src: The story may not be over.
segments.tr: A história pode não ter acabado.

segments.src: Insurers have already signaled that 2027 filings could bring further premium growth, driven by ongoing medical inflation and continued uncertainty about the size of the subsidized enrollee pool.
segments.tr: As seguradoras já sinalizaram que os registros de 2027 podem trazer um maior crescimento dos prêmios, impulsionado pela inflação médica contínua e pela incerteza persistente sobre o tamanho do grupo de inscritos subsidiados.

segments.src: Consumer advocates and some lawmakers have called for Congress to revisit an extension of the enhanced credits, while others argue the program was never intended to be permanent and that a return to pre-pandemic subsidy levels restores fiscal discipline to the exchanges.
segments.tr: Defensores do consumidor e alguns legisladores pediram ao Congresso que reconsidere uma extensão dos créditos aprimorados, enquanto outros argumentam que o programa nunca teve a intenção de ser permanente e que um retorno aos níveis de subsídio pré-pandemia restaura a disciplina fiscal aos mercados.

segments.src: As of now, no extension has been signed into law, and the debate is expected to continue as the next open enrollment period approaches.
segments.tr: Até o momento, nenhuma extensão foi sancionada, e espera-se que o debate continue à medida que o próximo período de inscrição aberta se aproxima.

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do
segments.tr: ## O Que os Inscritos Podem Fazer

segments.src: Financial advisors and consumer groups generally recommend a few practical steps for anyone affected by the change:
segments.tr: Consultores financeiros e grupos de defesa do consumidor geralmente recomendam alguns passos práticos para qualquer pessoa afetada pela mudança:

segments.src: 1. **Re-shop your plan.** A lower-premium plan on the same metal tier, or a different insurer's network, may reduce costs even without a subsidy.
segments.tr: 1. **Pesquise novamente seu plano.** Um plano com prêmio mais baixo na mesma categoria de metal, ou a rede de outra seguradora, pode reduzir os custos mesmo sem um subsídio.

segments.src: 2. **Check your actual eligibility.** Subsidy formulas are based on estimated household income, and some enrollees may still qualify for partial assistance depending on their specific circumstances.
segments.tr: 2. **Verifique sua elegibilidade real.** As fórmulas de subsídio são baseadas na renda familiar estimada, e alguns inscritos ainda podem se qualificar para assistência parcial, dependendo de suas circunstâncias específicas.

segments.src: 3. **Review deadlines carefully.** Marketplace enrollment windows and state-specific extensions vary, so missing a date can mean waiting months for another chance to change plans.
segments.tr: 3. **Revise os prazos com cuidado.** As janelas de inscrição no mercado e as extensões específicas de cada estado variam, portanto, perder uma data pode significar esperar meses por outra chance de mudar de plano.

segments.src: 4. **Talk to a licensed navigator or broker.** Free enrollment assistance is available in most states and can help identify plans or cost-sharing programs that fit a specific budget.
segments.tr: 4. **Fale com um navegador ou corretor licenciado.** A assistência gratuita para inscrição está disponível na maioria dos estados e pode ajudar a identificar planos ou programas de compartilhamento de custos que se ajustem a um orçamento específico.

segments.src: For personalized guidance, HealthCare.gov and state-run exchanges remain the official, authoritative source for eligibility rules, deadlines, and plan comparisons.
segments.tr: Para orientação personalizada, o HealthCare.gov e os mercados administrados pelo estado continuam sendo a fonte oficial e autorizada para regras de elegibilidade, prazos e comparações de planos.

segments.tr: Este artigo destina-se a fins informativos gerais e não substitui o aconselhamento financeiro ou de seguro individualizado.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## O Cenário Geral

segments.src: The end of the enhanced ACA subsidies is a reminder of how quickly a temporary government support program can reshape household budgets once it disappears.
segments.tr: O fim dos subsídios aprimorados do ACA é um lembrete de quão rapidamente um programa de apoio governamental temporário pode remodelar os orçamentos familiares assim que desaparece.

segments.src: For 22 million Americans who rely on the individual marketplace, the jump from an $888 average bill to one nearing $1,904 is not an abstract policy debate — it is a real number showing up in bank statements and monthly budgets across the country.

segments.tr: - **Peserta pedesaan**, yang biasanya memiliki lebih sedikit pilihan paket dan premi acuan yang lebih tinggi, juga melaporkan kenaikan yang sangat besar.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next

segments.src: Insurers have already signaled that 2027 filings could bring further premium growth, driven by ongoing medical inflation and continued uncertainty about the size of the subsidized enrollee pool.
segments.tr: Perusahaan asuransi telah memberi sinyal bahwa pengajuan tahun 2027 dapat membawa pertumbuhan premi lebih lanjut, didorong oleh inflasi medis yang berkelanjutan dan ketidakpastian yang terus berlanjut mengenai ukuran kumpulan peserta bersubsidi.

segments.src: Consumer advocates and some lawmakers have called for Congress to revisit an extension of the enhanced credits, while others argue the program was never intended to be permanent and that a return to pre-pandemic subsidy levels restores fiscal discipline to the exchanges.
segments.tr: Para advokat konsumen dan beberapa anggota parlemen telah meminta Kongres untuk meninjau kembali perpanjangan kredit yang ditingkatkan, sementara yang lain berpendapat bahwa program tersebut tidak pernah dimaksudkan untuk menjadi permanen dan bahwa kembali ke tingkat subsidi sebelum pandemi memulihkan disiplin fiskal ke bursa.

segments.src: As of now, no extension has been signed into law, and the debate is expected to continue as the next open enrollment period approaches.
segments.tr: Hingga saat ini, belum ada perpanjangan yang disahkan menjadi undang-undang, dan perdebatan diperkirakan akan terus berlanjut seiring mendekatnya periode pendaftaran terbuka berikutnya.

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dapat Dilakukan Peserta

segments.src: Financial advisors and consumer groups generally recommend a few practical steps for anyone affected by the change:
segments.tr: Penasihat keuangan dan kelompok konsumen umumnya merekomendasikan beberapa langkah praktis bagi siapa pun yang terkena dampak perubahan tersebut:

segments.src: 1. **Re-shop your plan.** A lower-premium plan on the same metal tier, or a different insurer's network, may reduce costs even without a subsidy.
segments.tr: 1. **Cari ulang paket Anda.** Paket dengan premi lebih rendah pada tingkat logam yang sama, atau jaringan perusahaan asuransi yang berbeda, dapat mengurangi biaya bahkan tanpa subsidi.

segments.src: 2. **Check your actual eligibility.** Subsidy formulas are based on estimated household income, and some enrollees may still qualify for partial assistance depending on their specific circumstances.
segments.tr: 2. **Periksa kelayakan Anda yang sebenarnya.** Rumus subsidi didasarkan pada perkiraan pendapatan rumah tangga, dan beberapa peserta mungkin masih memenuhi syarat untuk mendapatkan bantuan parsial tergantung pada keadaan spesifik mereka.

segments.src: 3. **Review deadlines carefully.** Marketplace enrollment windows and state-specific extensions vary, so missing a date can mean waiting months for another chance to change plans.
segments.tr: 3. **Tinjau tenggat waktu dengan cermat.** Jendela pendaftaran pasar dan perpanjangan khusus negara bagian bervariasi, jadi melewatkan tanggal bisa berarti menunggu berbulan-bulan untuk kesempatan lain mengubah paket.

segments.src: 4. **Talk to a licensed navigator or broker.** Free enrollment assistance is available in most states and can help identify plans or cost-sharing programs that fit a specific budget.
segments.tr: 4. **Bicaralah dengan navigator atau broker berlisensi.** Bantuan pendaftaran gratis tersedia di sebagian besar negara bagian dan dapat membantu mengidentifikasi paket atau program pembagian biaya yang sesuai dengan anggaran tertentu.

segments.src: For personalized guidance, HealthCare.gov and state-run exchanges remain the official, authoritative source for eligibility rules, deadlines, and plan comparisons.
segments.tr: Untuk panduan yang dipersonalisasi, HealthCare.gov dan bursa yang dikelola negara bagian tetap menjadi sumber resmi dan otoritatif untuk aturan kelayakan, tenggat waktu, dan perbandingan paket.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Gambaran yang Lebih Besar

segments.src: For 22 million Americans who rely on the individual marketplace, the jump from an $888 average bill to one nearing $1,904 is not an abstract policy debate — it is a real number showing up in bank statements and monthly budgets across the country.
segments.tr: Bagi 22 juta orang Amerika yang mengandalkan pasar individu, lonjakan dari rata-rata tagihan $888 menjadi hampir $1.904 bukanlah perdebatan kebijakan abstrak — itu adalah angka nyata yang muncul dalam laporan bank dan anggaran bulanan di seluruh negeri.

segments.src: How Washington responds in the months ahead could determine whether that gap widens further or narrows again.
segments.tr: Bagaimana Washington merespons dalam beberapa bulan mendatang dapat menentukan apakah kesenjangan itu semakin melebar atau menyempit kembali.

ja.title: 1,904ドルのプレミアム：2,200万人のアメリカ人がすでに感じているACA補助金終了の影響

segments.src: ## A Quiet Deadline With a Loud Impact
segments.tr: ## 静かな締め切り、大きな影響

segments.src: At the stroke of midnight on December 31, 2025, a temporary but consequential piece of pandemic-era policy quietly expired.
segments.tr: 2025年12月31日の深夜、パンデミック時代の政策の一時的かつ重要な一部が静かに失効しました。

segments.src: The enhanced premium tax credits for Affordable Care Act (ACA) marketplace plans — first introduced in 2021 and extended through 2025 — were allowed to lapse.
segments.tr: 2021年に初めて導入され、2025年まで延長されていた医療費負担適正化法（ACA）マーケットプレイスプラン向けの強化されたプレミアム税額控除が、期限切れとなりました。

segments.src: For millions of households who buy their own health insurance through HealthCare.gov or a state exchange, the change did not arrive with fanfare.
segments.tr: HealthCare.govや州の取引所を通じて独自の医療保険を購入している何百万もの世帯にとって、この変更は華々しく到来したわけではありません。

segments.src: It arrived with a bill.
segments.tr: 請求書とともに到来したのです。

segments.src: According to marketplace enrollment data, the average annual amount enrollees paid out of pocket for coverage had been about $888 while the enhanced credits were in effect.
segments.tr: マーケットプレイスの登録データによると、強化された控除が適用されていた期間中、加入者が自己負担した年間平均額は約888ドルでした。

segments.src: Now, with those credits gone, many shoppers are seeing that number climb toward an average of roughly $1,904 a year — more than double what they budgeted for just months earlier.
segments.tr: 現在、それらの控除がなくなったことで、多くの購入者はその数字が年間平均約1,904ドルに向けて上昇しているのを目の当たりにしています。これは、わずか数ヶ月前に予算化していた額の2倍以上です。

segments.src: ## Why Premiums Jumped
segments.tr: ## 保険料が跳ね上がった理由

segments.src: The enhanced tax credits did two main things: they increased the size of subsidies for people who already qualified for help, and they extended eligibility to middle-income households that previously earned too much to receive any assistance at all.
segments.tr: 強化された税額控除は主に2つのことを行いました。すでに支援の資格があった人々の補助金額を増額し、以前は所得が高すぎて支援を受けられなかった中所得世帯にも受給資格を拡大したのです。

segments.src: When the enhancement expired, both of those benefits reset to pre-2021 levels.
segments.tr: この強化措置が期限切れとなったことで、両方の恩恵が2021年以前の水準にリセットされました。

segments.src: For some enrollees, that means a smaller subsidy.
segments.tr: 一部の加入者にとっては、補助金が減額されることを意味します。

segments.src: For others — particularly those earning just above 400% of the federal poverty line — it means no subsidy at all.
segments.tr: また、連邦貧困ラインの400%をわずかに上回る所得層など、他の人々にとっては、補助金が全くなくなることを意味します。

segments.src: Insurers, anticipating the policy change, also filed for significant "sticker price" rate increases for 2026 plans, citing rising medical costs and the expectation that a healthier mix of subsidized customers might leave the marketplace.
segments.tr: 保険会社は政策変更を見越して、医療費の上昇と、補助金を受ける健康な加入者がマーケットプレイスから離れる可能性を理由に、2026年プランの「定価」の大幅な引き上げを申請しました。

segments.src: The combination of a smaller subsidy applied to a higher base premium is what produced the sharp jump many families are now seeing on their bills.
segments.tr: より高い基本保険料に少額の補助金が適用されるという組み合わせが、多くの家族が現在請求書で目にしている急激な上昇を生み出しています。

segments.src: ## Who Is Affected
segments.tr: ## 影響を受ける人々

segments.src: Roughly 22 million people enrolled in ACA marketplace plans during the most recent open enrollment period, and a large majority of them received some form of premium assistance.
segments.tr: 直近のオープンエンロールメント期間中にACAマーケットプレイスプランに登録した約2,200万人のうち、大多数が何らかの形の保険料支援を受けていました。

segments.src: Analysts who track the exchanges note that the impact is uneven:
segments.tr: 取引所を追跡しているアナリストは、影響が不均一であると指摘しています。

segments.src: - **Middle-income households** just above the old subsidy cutoff are seeing the steepest relative increases, since they may lose eligibility for help entirely.
segments.tr: - **中所得世帯**：以前の補助金打ち切りラインをわずかに上回る世帯は、支援の資格を完全に失う可能性があるため、相対的に最も急激な上昇を経験しています。

segments.src: - **Older enrollees**, whose premiums are already higher due to age-rating rules, face the largest dollar increases even when their percentage increase looks similar to younger enrollees.
segments.tr: - **高齢の加入者**：年齢別の料率ルールにより保険料がすでに高くなっているため、上昇率が若い加入者と同じように見えても、金額ベースでは最大の上昇に直面しています。

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers, early retirees, and gig workers** — groups with no employer-sponsored coverage option — are among the most exposed, since the marketplace is often their only source of insurance.
segments.tr: - **自営業者、早期退職者、ギグワーカー**：雇用主が提供する保険の選択肢がないグループであり、マーケットプレイスが唯一の保険源であることが多いため、最も影響を受けやすい層です。

segments.src: - **Rural enrollees**, who typically have fewer plan choices and higher benchmark premiums, are also reporting outsized increases.
segments.tr: - **地方の加入者**：通常、プランの選択肢が少なく、基準となる保険料が高いため、過大な上昇を報告しています。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の展望

segments.src: The story may not be over.
segments.tr: 物語はまだ終わっていないかもしれません。

segments.src: Insurers have already signaled that 2027 filings could bring further premium growth, driven by ongoing medical inflation and continued uncertainty about the size of the subsidized enrollee pool.
segments.tr: 保険会社はすでに、2027年の申請でさらなる保険料の上昇が起こる可能性があることを示唆しています。これは、進行中の医療インフレと、補助金を受ける加入者層の規模に関する継続的な不確実性が要因です。

segments.src: Consumer advocates and some lawmakers have called for Congress to revisit an extension of the enhanced credits, while others argue the program was never intended to be permanent and that a return to pre-pandemic subsidy levels restores fiscal discipline to the exchanges.
segments.tr: 消費者擁護団体や一部の議員は議会に対し、強化された控除の延長を再検討するよう求めていますが、一方で、このプログラムは恒久的なものではなく、パンデミック前の補助金水準に戻すことが取引所の財政規律を回復させると主張する人々もいます。

segments.src: As of now, no extension has been signed into law, and the debate is expected to continue as the next open enrollment period approaches.
segments.tr: 現時点では、延長は法制化されておらず、次のオープンエンロールメント期間が近づくにつれて議論が続くと予想されます。

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do
segments.tr: ## 加入者ができること

segments.src: Financial advisors and consumer groups generally recommend a few practical steps for anyone affected by the change:
segments.tr: ファイナンシャルアドバイザーや消費者団体は、この変更の影響を受けるすべての人に対して、一般的にいくつかの実践的なステップを推奨しています。

segments.src: 1. **Re-shop your plan.** A lower-premium plan on the same metal tier, or a different insurer's network, may reduce costs even without a subsidy.
segments.tr: 1. **プランを見直す。** 同じメタルティア（プランのランク）で保険料が低いプランや、別の保険会社のネットワークに切り替えることで、補助金がなくてもコストを削減できる可能性があります。

segments.src: 2. **Check your actual eligibility.** Subsidy formulas are based on estimated household income, and some enrollees may still qualify for partial assistance depending on their specific circumstances.
segments.tr: 2. **実際の資格を確認する。** 補助金の計算式は推定世帯年収に基づいており、個々の状況によっては、一部の加入者は依然として部分的な支援を受ける資格があるかもしれません。

segments.src: 3. **Review deadlines carefully.** Marketplace enrollment windows and state-specific extensions vary, so missing a date can mean waiting months for another chance to change plans.
segments.tr: 3. **締め切りを注意深く確認する。** マーケットプレイスの登録期間や州ごとの延長措置は異なるため、日付を逃すと、プランを変更する次のチャンスまで数ヶ月待たなければならない可能性があります。

segments.src: 4. **Talk to a licensed navigator or broker.** Free enrollment assistance is available in most states and can help identify plans or cost-sharing programs that fit a specific budget.
segments.tr: 4. **認定ナビゲーターやブローカーに相談する。** ほとんどの州で無料の登録支援が利用可能であり、特定の予算に合うプランや費用分担プログラムを見つける手助けをしてくれます。

segments.src: For personalized guidance, HealthCare.gov and state-run exchanges remain the official, authoritative source for eligibility rules, deadlines, and plan comparisons.

segments.tr: Finanzberater und Verbrauchergruppen empfehlen im Allgemeinen einige praktische Schritte für jeden, der von der Änderung betroffen ist:

segments.src: 1. **Re-shop your plan.** A lower-premium plan on the same metal tier, or a different insurer's network, may reduce costs even without a subsidy.
segments.tr: 1. **Suchen Sie erneut nach Ihrem Plan.** Ein Plan mit niedrigerer Prämie in derselben Metallstufe oder das Netzwerk eines anderen Versicherers kann die Kosten auch ohne Subvention senken.

segments.src: 2. **Check your actual eligibility.** Subsidy formulas are based on estimated household income, and some enrollees may still qualify for partial assistance depending on their specific circumstances.
segments.tr: 2. **Überprüfen Sie Ihre tatsächliche Anspruchsberechtigung.** Subventionsformeln basieren auf dem geschätzten Haushaltseinkommen, und einige Versicherte haben je nach ihren spezifischen Umständen möglicherweise immer noch Anspruch auf teilweise Unterstützung.

segments.src: 3. **Review deadlines carefully.** Marketplace enrollment windows and state-specific extensions vary, so missing a date can mean waiting months for another chance to change plans.
segments.tr: 3. **Überprüfen Sie Fristen sorgfältig.** Anmeldefenster für den Marktplatz und staatsspezifische Verlängerungen variieren, daher kann das Verpassen eines Datums bedeuten, monatelang auf eine weitere Chance zum Planwechsel warten zu müssen.

segments.src: 4. **Talk to a licensed navigator or broker.** Free enrollment assistance is available in most states and can help identify plans or cost-sharing programs that fit a specific budget.
segments.tr: 4. **Sprechen Sie mit einem lizenzierten Navigator oder Makler.** Kostenlose Anmeldehilfe ist in den meisten Bundesstaaten verfügbar und kann dabei helfen, Pläne oder Kostenteilungsprogramme zu identifizieren, die zu einem bestimmten Budget passen.

segments.src: For personalized guidance, HealthCare.gov and state-run exchanges remain the official, authoritative source for eligibility rules, deadlines, and plan comparisons.
segments.tr: Für eine persönliche Beratung bleiben HealthCare.gov und staatlich betriebene Börsen die offizielle, maßgebliche Quelle für Anspruchsregeln, Fristen und Planvergleiche.
